hosted-worker-verification.json.scope: Actual bundled application handler executing inside workerd with nodejs_compat, D1 and R2; local synthetic identity headers only.

groups: A first browser GET returns a blank account view without creating a workspace, salt, throttle or session
Anonymous requests and caller-forged authentication headers fail behind the modeled trusted Sites edge
Explicit account-bound creation and reopening create no native credential or pairing code
Browser PDF/profile writes use shared validation and actual private R2; valid native tokens never choose the browser owner
No browser mutation or receipt export accepts a native token or forged caller identity in place of Sites authentication
Every browser mutation rejects stale or missing account/workspace intent before any write, cleanup, throttle, PDF access or provider request
Workspace and bound receipt GETs remain read-only, including changed email and expired dispatch/session rows
All browser writes require the exact Origin and reject cross-site, same-site and navigation Fetch Metadata
The browser allowlist excludes native credential routes, rejects unknown fields, and applies bounded single-pass JSON parsing
Explicit same-account email refresh advances the revision once and invalidates old approval without creating or rotating phone credentials
Stale profile replay and unapproved, changed-digest or old-schema reviews cannot replace data or authorize a send
Explicit approval and continuation submit the exact reviewed PDF/LinkedIn payload once; repeat requests and duplicate reviews do not resend
An ambiguous browser dispatch remains durably uncertain and cannot be automatically retried or duplicated
Stop and provider-unavailable continuation preserve the existing fail-closed submission rules
Browser GETs, expired-plan advance and denied guarded Stop cannot reconcile or change expired dispatch claims
Browser Stop reconciles only the exact stopped plan’s expired claims, preserves live/other-owner claims and never resends
Manual LinkedIn jobs cause no fetch or receipt; receipt exports remain account-bound and contain no PDF bytes
A deleted and recreated workspace rejects stale requests even when the signed-in account is unchanged
A pending deletion remains visible and read-only while browser creation, mutations and receipt downloads stay locked without cleanup
hosted-phone-verification.json.scope: Bundled production application handler inside actual workerd with real local D1 and R2. Provider HTTP is synthetic and all real outbound requests are forbidden.

checks: Public catalog has seven verified sources, four mixed defaults and no account dependency
Phone client accepts actual default-board and EU search responses without a catalog-only region field
Strict source normalization accepts board and direct-posting links without arbitrary fetch URLs
Invalid filters, source counts and cursor parameters are rejected before provider traffic
Public requests ignore account credentials and never persist or forward personal search terms
Provider identities, plain text, unknown country and remote evidence remain distinct
Keyword AND, location text and remote-only filters operate on public metadata
Shared board caching survives handler recreation and preserves original observation time
Stable cursors page a fair multi-source result without duplicates and bind the original filters
Refreshing a source invalidates old cursors instead of silently mixing snapshots
A failed source retains visibly stale facts while successful sources remain current
Expired stale data and complete source failures are unavailable rather than an empty successful search
A missing board clears cached vacancies and the negative cooldown suppresses repeated requests
Provider Retry-After is honored while cached timestamps remain unchanged
D1 leases coalesce concurrent isolates without process-local queues
Expired claims recover and late completions cannot overwrite a newer successful snapshot
Malformed provider data is attributed and never becomes a successful empty board
Job-count and UTF-8 cache-byte limits remain below a D1 row and disclose partial coverage
A later temporary Lever failure preserves validated pages as partial and recovers after cooldown
The unchanged source deadline keeps completed Lever pages and starts no over-budget page
A later Lever rate limit keeps validated jobs while honoring the complete Retry-After interval
A removed Lever board never keeps an earlier page as a partial current result
A later Lever body disconnect keeps validated jobs and permits a later complete refresh
A real later-page body timeout cancels the reader while preserving completed Lever pages
A later-page shared budget denial preserves jobs without an extra GET or early retry
A malformed later Lever page is not salvaged as a fresh prefix
A redirected later Lever page is not salvaged as a fresh prefix
A new partial snapshot invalidates old cursors and never mixes an old cached tail
A long provider cooldown outlives freshness and stale retention without sliding or new traffic
Lever pages are bounded to five public GETs and 500 normalized postings
Wrong MIME type releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Oversized declared body releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Invalid declared body length releases its unread transport and remains an unavailable source
Header rejection preserves its error when transport cleanup is reject
Header rejection preserves its error when transport cleanup is pending
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for resolve cleanup
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for reject cleanup
Streamed overflow releases its reader without waiting for pending cleanup
A body-rejection cooldown permits a clean successful refresh without false empty-cache success
Redirects and oversized responses are refused without following untrusted destinations
A response arriving after timeout releases its unread body without changing the timeout outcome
A stalled response body is cancelled within the bounded provider timeout
Client and missing-IP request budgets are shared, atomic and return Retry-After
Custom negative cache capacity and fetch budgets reserve service for the catalog
Concurrent custom source admission cannot exceed the durable cache quota
Security counters expire without storing raw IPs or requiring an applicant account
Actual bundled workerd runs eight public discovery requests with real D1 and no account or R2
hosted-discovery-verification.json.scope: Actual local D1 SQL concurrency/quotas/cache with production discovery handler and synthetic bounded provider GETs; actual bundled workerd public API requests. Every successful response is parsed by the phone client model. Real public source availability is recorded separately.

groups: Unconfigured production service exposes no live connector or fixture switch
Identity, origin and unauthenticated boundaries; account GET is read-only
Concurrent redemption consumes exactly one code and creates one token
Actual 5 MiB PDF persists in private R2 with small D1 metadata and exact hash
Concurrent profile saves preserve one acknowledged revision and exact previous PDF
Account PDF downloads require matching platform identity
Unapproved reviews and GET workspace never dispatch
Exact multipart PDF, single name, explicit No, confirmed test receipt and guarded approval
Confirmed attempts never resend and block duplicate preparations
An unverified profile email cannot reveal whether another workspace has a confirmed application
Same-workspace duplicate protection survives an unverified profile email change
Cross-workspace duplicate protection remains available for the verified account email
Approval versus guarded Stop is atomic across concurrent requests
Concurrent advance claims one POST; deletion refuses active provider dispatch
Transport uncertainty is durable and cannot be resent or re-prepared
Mixed ready/429 plan needs a fresh approval after cooldown, not an earlier generation
Provider acceptance followed by result-write failure stays uncertain
GET does not mutate interrupted claims; advance recovers expiry without resending
Expired-plan GET and denied advance/guarded Stop leave dispatch claims unchanged
A failed expiry-reconciliation write rolls back the plan stop and queued cancellation atomically
Explicit Stop reconciles only this stopped plan’s expired leases, preserves live and foreign claims, and never resends
Account export contains owned records and workspace-bound private PDF paths without tokens or provider secrets
Real R2 tombstones fence late conditional puts in both orderings and erase metadata
Stale or missing account intent cannot create a workspace, refresh email, or rotate another account pairing code
Stale workspace confirmation cannot delete, revoke, recover, or alter expired dispatch state in either account
Stale, missing, or ambiguous download targets cannot expose another account export or read its PDF
Missing or incomplete platform identity fails closed even with a valid-looking action precondition
The preserved code redeems normally while expired codes and phone sessions cannot regain access
Terminated upload before/after R2 write recovers with no original phone or PDF
An expired upload reservation can be retried under a fresh durable claim
Account deletion erases pending uploads and prevents a late writer resurrecting PDF data
Failed erasure remains locked and retries without falsely reporting deletion
Health checks verify actual R2 accessibility as well as D1
Owner can revoke a phone; revoked credentials cannot access saved data
Full profile handler cannot restore a delayed PDF or records after successful deletion
A stale recovery cannot fence the fresh claim committed by a concurrent phone retry
Saved-opportunity quota remains atomic under concurrent requests
PDF reservation quota remains atomic before concurrent R2 writes
Account GET reports a changed platform email without rebasing data, revision, or prior approval
Explicit pairing refreshes changed platform email and invalidates old approval until the profile is corrected
LinkedIn profile URLs are canonical, optional, separate from portfolio and preserved by older phone saves; invalid updates preserve data
Older clients cannot create or approve a recovered review containing an undisplayed LinkedIn URL; preparation sends nothing
An explicitly approved LinkedIn profile URL is included exactly in the immutable snapshot and provider multipart payload
Clearing a link invalidates prior approval; saved LinkedIn job URLs remain manual and never produce automatic-submission receipts
Truncated and page-less PDFs fail a real parser before profile revision, stored bytes or records can change
PDF removal rejects a current profile reference or a stale/foreign workspace target without changing either account
Unused PDF erasure releases its quota, preserves historical fingerprints, fences files and remains idempotent
A concurrent profile save cannot reattach a PDF retired after its upload lookup
Employer requirements expiring during posting/PDF preflight produce no application POST
Requirements expiry while persisting the dispatch claim is rechecked before POST without inventing a dispatch
Two-day provider cooldowns are not shortened and an unreadable cooldown stays blocked after Stop
Invalid employer configuration disables submission while account access, export, revocation and erasure remain usable
A legacy missing or damaged stored PDF is caught during review before an approval or dispatch record exists
In-flight provider dispatch retains its exact PDF; a failed later erasure is visible and safely retriable without losing the receipt
Google cookie identity owns account/phone access and a scoped metadata export; invalid cookies never expose a different Sites account or affect native bearer access
Identity-only account erasure revokes its sessions and links without creating a workspace or changing another signed-in account
A workspace created during identity-only deletion prevents the stale deletion atomically
Google pairing and browser-open requests already in flight cannot recreate a deleted owner or mint a phone code
Opaque owner generations stop stale Sites pairing/open requests before or after lifecycle capture, while a deliberate later request can start fresh
Full Google-owned workspace erasure removes identity and application state together and preserves the other browser account
LinkedIn session identity owns its verified email, workspace, export and deletion without exposing another browser account
Revoked LinkedIn sessions cannot finish delayed pairing or workspace creation
Global free-service account cap is atomic rather than count-then-create
